pictures.name: dry_valley_at_dusk
pictures.scene: a narrow dry valley of stone and scrub closing in at dusk, the nearest rocks lit low and warm along the bottom of the frame, the slopes above them going dark and near and heavy against a fading sky

pictures.name: stone_refuge_in_the_cliff
pictures.scene: a deep cleft in a cliff wall wide enough to shelter in, its floor lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the enormous rock above and around the opening dim and solid and entirely unbroken

pictures.name: viper_coiled_in_the_dust
pictures.scene: one small grey viper coiled tight in warm dust beside a flat stone, its scales lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the dry ground beyond it running away pale and flat and out of focus

pictures.name: barred_door_from_within
pictures.scene: a heavy timber door seen from inside with its bar dropped firmly into place, the bar and the boards lit warm by one lamp low in the frame, the room above and around them dark and close and quiet

pictures.name: hidden_snare_in_the_grass
pictures.scene: a thin cord snare set open and half buried in dry grass across a narrow path, the loop and the pegs lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the track beyond it going away flat and unremarkable

pictures.name: high_rock_above_the_plain
pictures.scene: a great blunt rock standing high above an open plain with clear air all around it, its near shoulder lit warm and gold, the far country below and the sky above it soft and blue and very quiet

pictures.name: bronze_shield_leaning
pictures.scene: a round bronze shield leaning upright against a stone wall, its face scarred and dull and catching one warm low light at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and grey and deep in shadow

pictures.name: bent_bow_unstrung
pictures.scene: a war bow lying unstrung on bare ground with its cord loose beside it, the wood lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the dust and low shadow above it brown and empty and undisturbed

pictures.name: heap_of_stones_thrown_down
pictures.scene: a tumbled heap of dressed stones fallen from a wall that no longer stands, the nearest blocks lit low and warm, the empty ground and sky above them flat and dull and holding nothing upright at all

pictures.name: coals_scattered_on_the_ground
pictures.scene: live coals spilled and scattered across bare earth and still glowing, the nearest embers lit fierce and red at the bottom of the frame, the ground and the night air above them dark and thick with smoke

pictures.name: deep_mire_at_the_pit_bottom
pictures.scene: the floor of a deep pit filled with thick grey mire, the wet surface catching one dull light at the bottom of the frame, the sheer earth walls rising away above it dark and streaked and without a hold

pictures.name: uprooted_thorn_bush
pictures.scene: a dead thorn bush torn out by its roots and lying on stony ground, the pale dry root ball lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the swept plain beyond it running out bare and colourless

pictures.name: balanced_scales_of_bronze
pictures.scene: a pair of bronze scales hanging still and level from a wooden beam, the two pans lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the beam and the wall above them plain and dim and altogether quiet

pictures.name: bright_courtyard_open_to_the_sky
pictures.scene: a wide swept courtyard standing open to full daylight, the near paving lit warm and clean along the bottom of the frame, the low walls and the bright sky above them pale and calm and free of any detail

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men.
Protect me from men of violence,
who devise evil in their hearts
and stir up war all day long.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes;
the venom of vipers is on their lips.
Selah
Guard me, O LORD,
from the hands of the wicked.
Keep me safe from men of violence
who scheme to make me stumble.
The proud hide a snare for me;
the cords of their net are spread along the path,
and lures are set out for me.
Selah
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.”
Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
You shield my head in the day of battle.
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked;
do not promote their evil plans,
lest they be exalted.
Selah
May the heads of those who surround me
be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
May burning coals fall on them;
may they be thrown into the fire,
into the miry pits, never to rise again.
May no slanderer be established in the land;
may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor
and defends the cause of the needy.
Surely the righteous will praise Your name;
the upright will dwell in Your presence.
